zh_summary: @deepakshenoy는 중국이 일찍이 Facebook과 Google을 금지했으므로 미국이 보복하는 것일 수 있다고 논의합니다. 인도는 자동차 수입에 관세를 부과하여 자동차 산업과 일부 수출이 있습니다. 모든 반도체 회사에 설계 서비스를 제공하지만 현지에서 만들지 않으며 중국에서 터널 보링 기계 같은 중공업 장비를 구매합니다. 능력을 구축하지 않으면 근시안적입니다. 중국은 사지 않을 것이고 미국은 결국 관세와 비관세 장벽을 둘 것입니다. 자체 소비를 위한 현지 능력이 필요합니다. 국내 철도 엔진, 신호 시스템, 중장비, 원자력 등에서 천천히 진전하는 것이 기뽑니다. 이사회 정치나 체면 상실에 대한 분노가 아닌 더 많이 만드는 데 집중해야 합니다.
text:
It is true that china banned facebook and google etc earlier so maybe it's a tit for tat by america instead. 

But then. We have a car industry domestically and now some exports because we have applied tariffs on car imports (not banned them). We do design services for all semiconductor companies but we don't make them here, and indeed even buy heavy engineering stuff like tunnel borers from China. This is short sighted, if we don't build capability. China isn't going to buy our stuff. America eventually will put tariff and non tariff barriers on our stuff. We need local capability not as much for exports but for our own consumption. I'm glad we are getting there slowly, with domestic rail engines, signalling systems, some heavy equipment, nuclear etc. Just need to put head down and make more, the focus on boardroom politics or outrage about loss of face is misguided imo

text:
I’ve long felt that a $SPCX - $TSLA deal is inevitable since Elon controls 48% of $SPCX as-converted shares and 10.5% of TSLA shares. Since any deal would be $SPCX stock for $TSLA stock the deal will not be as compelling as many on X believe, given the massive dilution and all-equity economics.  I expect a SPCX offer price in the neighborhood of $420/TSLA share, and as in most stock-for-stock deals will likely get arbitraged down given the approximate 6-12 months needed between a deal announcement and deal close.  

I would expect the combined SPCX/TSLA multiple of EBITDA or EPS to follow the acquiring company’s multiple, which in this case is $SPCX and is lower than TSLA’s FY’27 EV/Ebitda multiple (TSLA 72.6x, SPCX 29.4x).  All told, I don’t expect a huge windfall for TSLA shareholders on a SPCX/TSLA stock-for-stock deal, although the announcement itself would be positive for TSLA stock.
